assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one high quality transparent ornamental civilization insignia for the HÜKÜM historical strategy game's UI. Create ONE new standalone symmetrical collectible-quality embossed metal crest. Dominant antique gold, deep burgundy and black. Render rich tangible gilded relief, fine engraved material, controlled polished highlights from upper left, subtle dark recesses and deep bevels.
